result.instructions: Tools for Homerun, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our job vacancies are currently published?"; "How many applications came in for the barista vacancy?"; "Show the details and notes on the newest job application.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Homerun data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run homerun_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run homerun_request_feature to record the request. Paid options: a 7-day pass ($5 once, no subscription, unlimited calls for 7 days) or Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year). When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run homerun_upgrade (plan "pass", "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. homerun_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: homerun_list_vacancies
tools.title: List vacancies
tools.description: List job vacancies (draft, private, public, ...) with title, status, type, location type and expiry. Optionally include location, department, hiring stages (their ids are what homerun_move_application_to_stage needs), salary indication and the candidate count. GET /vacancies (scope vacancies:read).

status.description: Only vacancies in these statuses, e.g. ["public","private"] or ["draft"].

include.description: Extra data to include. Use stages to see the hiring stage ids.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: homerun_get_vacancy
tools.title: Get vacancy
tools.description: One vacancy by id with description, location, department, hiring stages (id + name), salary indication, candidate count and the public job and application-form URLs. GET /vacancies/{vacancy_id} (scope vacancies:read).

tools.name: homerun_list_applications
tools.title: List applications (candidates)
tools.description: List job applications, newest page first as the API orders them. Each item has name, e-mail, vacancy id, current stage (id + name), rating, created/hired dates and disqualified flag. Personal data: no phone number, date of birth, photo or files are returned here; ask for one application with homerun_get_application. Filter by vacancy, stage name or disqualified state and page through; do not use it to export all candidates. GET /job-applications (scope job-applications:read).

vacancy_id.description: Only applications of these vacancy ids (filter[vacancy_id]).

stage.description: Only applications in the hiring stage with this name (stage names belong to a vacancy, so combine with vacancy_id).

disqualified.description: true = only disqualified, false = only not disqualified.

hired_after.description: Only applicants hired after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

include_sources.description: Also return the sources (e.g. Homerun Career Page, Indeed) of each application.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: homerun_get_application
tools.title: Get application (candidate)
tools.description: One job application in full: contact details (name, e-mail, phone, city, country), links, experience/education, current stage, rating, sources and file names (notes: use homerun_list_notes). Date of birth, photo URL and file download links are never returned. Optionally include the answers to the application-form questions. Personal data: fetch only the candidate you need. GET /job-applications/{job_application_id} (scope job-applications:read).

include_answers.description: Also return the application-form questions and the candidate's answers.

tools.name: homerun_list_notes
tools.title: List application notes
tools.description: List the notes on one application: id, author display name, text, sensitive flag and timestamps. GET /job-applications/{job_application_id}/notes (scope job-application-notes:read).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: homerun_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the company's candidate tags (id + name). GET /tags (scope tags:read).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: homerun_list_application_tags
tools.title: List an application's tags
tools.description: The tags attached to one application. GET /job-applications/{job_application_id}/tags (scope job-application-tags:read).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: homerun_move_application_to_stage
tools.title: Move application to a stage
tools.description: WRITE: move ONE application to another hiring stage of its vacancy (PATCH with only the stage id; nothing else on the application changes). Get stage ids from homerun_get_vacancy. Homerun's own automations for that stage may run (for example automatic e-mails configured in Homerun); this tool sends no e-mail itself and does not reject or delete anyone. PATCH /job-applications/{job_application_id} (scope job-applications:write).

stage_id.description: Hiring stage id from the vacancy's stages (homerun_get_vacancy).

tools.name: homerun_add_note
tools.title: Add a note to an application
tools.description: WRITE: add ONE note (1-2000 characters) to one application. It becomes visible to the hiring team in Homerun and cannot be removed with this server. display_name is free text shown as the author. Nothing is sent to the candidate. POST /job-applications/{job_application_id}/notes (scope job-application-notes:write).

display_name.description: Author name shown on the note (default "AI assistant").

is_sensitive.description: Mark the note as sensitive (restricts who can read it in Homerun).

annotations.title: Add a note to an application
